name: The Oneiric Concord
description: A radical splinter of the Veil Wardens who believe controlled fusion with the dream realm is the only path to salvation.
goals: Establish permanent, stabilized dream-gates in select Anchorholds
Forge a diplomatic treaty with organized dream entities
Discredit and undermine the purist Veil Wardens' authority
resources: Renegade Wardens with experimental fusion rituals, hidden sanctuaries in mutable zones, sympathizers among citizens weary of constant fear.
